title: 117 The Weekend - I’m Sorry I Love You IX

content.text: Hello English learners, welcome back to EnglishPod. My name is Mark Ong.
content.trans: 您好英语学习者，欢迎再次来到英语pod。我的名字是马克·奥恩。

content.text: And I'm Erica.
content.trans: 我是艾瑞克。

content.text: And today we're bringing you part 9 of our romantic drama suspense action series.
content.trans: 今天，我们为您带来第9集我们的浪漫悬疑动作系列。

content.text: I'm sorry I love you.
content.trans: 我非常抱歉，我爱你。

content.text: This is actually our penultimate lesson.
content.trans: 这是我们的最后一堂课。

content.text: Exactly. This story will end in part 10, so we're almost done. What's happening?
content.trans: 是的。这个故事将在第10部分结束，所以我们已经接近完成了。发生了什么？

content.text: Well, I am pretty excited to find out, so why don't we go straight into the dialogue
content.trans: 嗯，我挺高兴能知道的，所以为什么不直接进入对话呢？

content.text: and catch up with Stephen and Veronica.
content.trans: 和斯蒂芬和维罗尼卡一起追赶。

content.text: Veronica, wait. Come on honey, get back in the car. Let's hug it over, okay?
content.trans: Veronica, 等一下。妈妈，快点回来坐车。让我们把它抱起来，好吗？

content.text: No. I'm tired of your lies. I don't know who you are anymore.
content.trans: 我厌倦了你的谎言。我不再知道你是谁了。

content.text: Veronica, it's me. The man that has and always will love you.
content.trans: Veronica，这是你。永远爱你的那个人。

content.text: I'm sorry that I've lied to you. Believe me. It's been hard for me as well.
content.trans: 对不起，我撒谎了。相信我。对我来说，这对我来说很难。

content.text: And time and again, I've thought of coming clean. But I couldn't put you or my mission at risk.
content.trans: 并且，我反复思考过要坦白。然而，我无法将你的或我的使命置于危险之中。

content.text: It's all over now. My assignment is complete. And now I have to go back to India.
content.trans: 现在一切都结束了。我的任务已完成，现在我必须返回印度。

content.text: What? Are you kidding? Is there anything else I should know before I never see you again?
content.trans: 什么？你是不是在开玩笑？我再也不会见到你了。

content.text: How could you deceive me like that?
content.trans: 如何能骗我像这样？

content.text: Yes.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: Veronica, I know that this isn't the best time and you probably hate me right now,
content.trans: Veronica, 我知道现在不是最好的时机，你可能讨厌我了。

content.text: but I want to be completely forthright with you. I know deep in my heart that you are the best thing that has ever happened to me.
content.trans: 但是，我想完全坦诚地与您交流。我知道，在我心中，你是我所经历的最好的事情之一。

content.text: Veronica, will you marry me? Come with me to India, baby.
content.trans: Veronica，你会嫁给我吗？跟我去印度吧。

content.text: I can't make it for everything that's happened, but I can promise you my undying love.
content.trans: 我不能为所有的发生的事情而改变，但我保证我的永恒爱恋。

content.text: I will be the most devoted husband and I will cherish you always.
content.trans: 我将永远是你的最忠诚的丈夫，我会永远爱你。

content.text: Stephen, I can't just leave everything at the drop of a hat.
content.trans: 在斯蒂芬，我不能只把一切都交给一个空架子。

content.text: With everything that has happened between us, I just don't know you anymore.
content.trans: 翻译成中文是：

content.text: I just can't build a relationship on a foundation of lies.
content.trans: 我根本不能建立在谎言之上的关系。

content.text: I do love you, but I can't go with you. I'm sorry. I love you.
content.trans: 我爱您，但我不愿意跟你一起去。对不起。我爱你。

content.text: This is the last call for flight A15 from Los Angeles to Hyderabad.
content.trans: 这是从洛杉矶飞往赫尔默特的最后呼叫。

content.text: I'm sorry, sir. We can't wait any longer. You must board the plane. Are you waiting for someone?
content.trans: 对不起，先生。我们不能再等了。你必须登机。你是等谁的？

content.text: I was, but I don't think she's coming.
content.trans: 我曾经，但我不认为她会来。

content.text: All right, so it seems like our poor Stephen is going home by himself.
content.trans: 好的，所以似乎我们的可怜的斯蒂芬先生独自一人回家了。

content.text: It's so sad.
content.trans: 是太悲伤了。

content.text: I know. He proposed. She didn't accept. He's going back to India by himself.
content.trans: 我知道。他提议，她没有接受。他打算自己回到印度。

content.text: I think this must be one of the worst feelings in the world.
content.trans: 我认为这一定是世界上最糟糕的感受。

content.text: Wondering if the person you love is going to show up at the last minute and realizing they aren't.
content.trans: 你爱的人可能会突然出现，但意识到他们不会。

content.text: I think it's very common of movies. You always expect the person to come running and show up.
content.trans: 我认为电影很常见。你总是期望那个人会突然出现并跑过来。

content.text: But as you can see, our dialogues are more realistic, so it didn't happen in this case.
content.trans: 但是，正如你所见，我们的对话更加真实，因此在这一例中并没有发生。

content.text: It's more realistic. Let's not debate that topic. Let's go straight into the language now with language takeaway.
content.trans: 它更真实。让我们不要争论这个问题。现在，让我们直面语言，分享我们的观点和经验。

content.text: Language takeaway.
content.trans: 语言小贴士。

content.text: All right. So today on language takeaway, we have six words that we're going to be looking at.
content.trans: 好的。今天在语言小课堂上，我们将讨论六个我们要学习的短语。

content.text: And let's get started with the first one.
content.trans: 让我们开始第一项。

content.text: Okay. So we've got language about love and language about telling the truth.
content.trans: 好的。所以我们已经有了关于爱的语言和关于诚实的讲述语言。

content.text: And the first one is a word about telling the truth.
content.trans: 第一个是关于诚实的。

content.text: So Stephen said, I've thought of coming clean.
content.trans: 所以斯蒂芬说，我已经考虑过坦白。

content.text: Okay. To come clean.
content.trans: 好的。坦白一下。

content.text: To come clean.
content.trans: 要坦白。

content.text: Now, if I want to come clean, it means I want to.
content.trans: 现在，如果我想要坦白，就是想。

content.text: You want to admit to something or to tell the truth about something you've been hiding.
content.trans: 您想承认什么或告诉真相，您一直在隐藏的事情。

content.text: Exactly. Okay. So I want to finally tell the truth or confess.
content.trans: 是的。好的。我想最后告诉真相或者承认。

content.text: So someone needs to come clean about who stole the chocolate out of the kitchen.
content.trans: 所以有人需要坦白，谁是偷走巧克力的那个人。

content.text: Okay. Come clean. So Stephen wanted to come clean on many occasions, but Veronica said,
content.trans: 好的。请坦白。所以斯蒂芬多次想坦白，但维欧拉说：

content.text: how could you deceive me like that?
content.trans: 如何能像这样欺骗我？

content.text: To deceive someone.
content.trans: 要欺骗别人。

content.text: How could you deceive me?
content.trans: 如何能骗我？

content.text: So to deceive someone.
content.trans: 所以要欺骗别人。

content.text: All right. To deceive.
content.trans: 好的。欺骗。

content.text: You, when you deceive somebody, you make them believe something that is untrue.
content.trans: 当您欺骗别人时，您让他们相信一个不真实的事实。

content.text: So you kind of trick them. Yeah. Yeah.
content.trans: 所以你有点耍他们。对，对。

content.text: Okay. Make them believe or see something that is not really true.
content.trans: 好的。让他们相信或看到什么不是真的。

content.text: Exactly. All right. So that's the verb to deceive.
content.trans: 是的。好的。这就是欺骗的动词。

content.text: Now, the noun, the action of doing this is called deception.
content.trans: 现在，名词、做这件事的行动称为欺骗。

content.text: It was all a great deception.
content.trans: 是整个都是个大骗局。

content.text: Okay. So a big trick. Something a big untruth.
content.trans: 好的。那么一个大骗局。一个大的谎言。

content.text: You deceived me.
content.trans: 您欺骗了我。

content.text: All right. Very good.
content.trans: 好的。很好。

content.text: Now, the opposite of deceive is to be forthright.
content.trans: 现在，相反的欺骗是坦诚。

content.text: Forthright.
content.trans: 直爽。

content.text: So Stephen wants to be completely forthright with Veronica.
content.trans: 所以斯蒂芬想完全坦率地跟维奥拉说。

content.text: Okay. I want to be forthright with you.
content.trans: 好的。我要坦诚地与你交流。

content.text: All right. When you are forthright with somebody, you are very honest and truthful with them, right?
content.trans: 好的。当你直率地对某人说话时，你很诚实和坦率，对吗？

content.text: Direct.
content.trans: 直接 (Dìzì).

content.text: You tell them the truth and everything directly.
content.trans: 您告诉他们真相，一切直接。

content.text: And you don't, so you don't like hide it or soften it or anything.
content.trans: 你也不，所以你就不会掩饰它、淡化或做任何其他事情。

content.text: Very good. So forthright.
content.trans: 很好。那么坦率。

content.text: All right. So three words about honesty.
content.trans: 好的。所以三句话关于诚实。

content.text: Now we've got three words about love for you.
content.trans: 现在我们有三个关于你爱的词汇。

content.text: So Stephen promised Veronica his undying love.
content.trans: 所以斯蒂芬许诺维拉永远爱着他。

content.text: My undying love.
content.trans: 我的永恒爱恋。

content.text: My undying love.
content.trans: 我的永恒爱恋。

content.text: Now undying.
content.trans: 现在永恒。

content.text: Well, I think it's pretty easy, right? It won't die.
content.trans: 嗯，我觉得很容易。它不会死。

content.text: It won't die exactly.
content.trans: 它不会死。

content.text: So he's offering her his forth, his love forever.
content.trans: 所以，他就是给了她他的全部，永远的爱。

content.text: A very romantic phrase.
content.trans: 一个非常浪漫的短语。

content.text: Very romantic.
content.trans: 非常浪漫。

content.text: And he also promised to be a devoted husband.
content.trans: 他还承诺要是一个忠诚的丈夫。

content.text: Devoted husband.
content.trans: 译文：忠诚的丈夫。

content.text: I'll be the most devoted husband.
content.trans: 我会是最忠诚的丈夫。

content.text: Now this word devoted. What am I saying there?
content.trans: 现在这个字很特别。我在这里说什么？

content.text: So as a devoted husband, Stephen really, really would love his wife.
content.trans: 所以作为一位忠诚的丈夫，斯蒂芬真的、真的会爱他的妻子。

content.text: He'd really look after her well and he would put all of his energy into that, into his marriage, right?
content.trans: 他真的会照顾好她，而且他将全力以赴地投入到她的婚姻中。

content.text: Okay. So he would be very committed to her.
content.trans: 好的。所以他非常愿意和她在一起。

content.text: Mm-hmm. And work really hard.
content.trans: 嗯，嗯。好好工作。

content.text: Now can I change the noun husband for something else?
content.trans: 现在能改变丈夫的名词是什么？

content.text: Yeah. We can talk about a devoted friend.
content.trans: 是的。我们可以谈论一个忠诚的朋友。

content.text: Or a devoted father.
content.trans: 一个忠诚的父亲。

content.text: Or a devoted employee.
content.trans: 一个忠诚的员工。

content.text: Very good.
content.trans: 很好。

content.text: And our last word about love.
content.trans: 我们的最后一句话是关于爱。

content.text: Well, Stephen also promises to cherish Veronica.
content.trans: 嗯，斯蒂芬还承诺要爱护维奥拉。

content.text: Okay. I will cherish you always.
content.trans: 好的。我将永远爱你。

content.text: I will cherish you always.
content.trans: 我将永远爱你。

content.text: So if I cherish somebody like my girlfriend, what would that mean?
content.trans: 所以，如果我像我的女朋友一样珍视某人，那意味着什么？

content.text: That means you hold her in your heart.
content.trans: 这句话的中文翻译是：

content.text: Like you really love her and you really respect her and you hold her close in your heart.
content.trans: 像你真的爱她，像你真的尊重她，你深深地把她放在心上。

content.text: Okay. So I respect her and maybe you don't take that person for granted.
content.trans: 好的。所以我尊重她，或许你并不因此而对她心存感激。

content.text: Mm-hmm.
content.trans: 对不起，我无法直接翻译成中文。不过，根据您提供的英文，请告诉我需要翻译的内容是什么？这样我可以更好地帮助您。

content.text: Okay. To cherish someone.
content.trans: 好的。为了珍惜某人。

content.text: Yeah. All right. So some nice honesty words, some nice love words.
content.trans: 是的。行啊。所以一些真诚的赞美之词，一些真挚的爱情之语。

content.text: And I think now we can move on to some interesting phrases with Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 现在，我们可以转向一些有趣的话题，使用 Fluent Builder。

content.text: Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 流畅 builder.

content.text: All right. So Veronica was upset. She didn't want to get in back in the car.
content.trans: 好的。所以维戈尔很生气。她不想回到车里。

content.text: And Stephen said, let's talk it over. Okay.
content.trans: 斯蒂芬说，让我们好好谈谈。 okay.

content.text: Let's talk it over.
content.trans: 让我们好好谈谈。

content.text: Let's talk it over.
content.trans: 让我们好好谈谈。

content.text: To talk something over.
content.trans: 和你谈谈。

content.text: Now, if I tell you that I want to talk it over, what am I saying?
content.trans: 现在，如果我告诉你我要和你讨论，我是怎么说的？

content.text: Obviously you want to talk about it, right?
content.trans: 当然，你想谈谈这个了。

content.text: But you want to talk about it for some time.
content.trans: 但是你希望花一些时间来讨论这个问题。

content.text: So really talk about all of the problems and the issues and everything.
content.trans: 所以真的谈谈所有的问题和问题，以及一切。

content.text: So try and make things clear.
content.trans: 所以试着把事情说清楚。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: All right. And also when he was confessing, he said,
content.trans: 好的。而且当他承认的时候，他说，

content.text: time and again I've thought of coming clean.
content.trans: 我反复思考过，是否应该坦白。

content.text: So this phrase time and again.
content.trans: 所以这句话时间一再重复。

content.text: Time and again.
content.trans: 时间总是重复出现。

content.text: Time and again.
content.trans: 时间总是。

content.text: So that's basically the same as saying again and again or many times.
content.trans: 所以，基本上就是重复和多次说或者很多次。

content.text: Right. So time and again, I've thought of quitting smoking, but never really have done it.
content.trans: 正确。因此，我反复思考过戒烟的问题，但从未真正尝试过。

content.text: So you've thought many times of doing it.
content.trans: 所以您已经反复考虑过去做这件事。

content.text: Time and again.
content.trans: 时间总是重复出现。

content.text: Yep.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: All right. So let's go to our next phrase.
content.trans: 好的。那么我们再转到下一个短语。

content.text: Now Veronica said, I can't just leave everything at the drop of a hat.
content.trans: 现在维多利亚说，我不能只把一切都交给一个空架子。

content.text: At the drop of a hat.
content.trans: 在一瞬间。

content.text: At the drop of a hat.
content.trans: At the drop of a hat." translates to "在一瞬间。" in Chinese.

content.text: So this is a very interesting and colloquial way of saying immediately.
content.trans: 所以，这是一种非常有趣且口语化的表达方式。

content.text: Mm hmm. So why don't we hear a few examples of how this is used in English?
content.trans: 嗯，嗯。所以我们为什么不听听一些用英语的例子呢？

content.text: Example one.
content.trans: 例子一。

content.text: My boss expects me to come into work at the drop of a hat.
content.trans: 我的老板希望我一听到铃声就立刻上班。

content.text: Example two.
content.trans: 翻译成中文是：

content.text: Laura is always willing to help me at the drop of a hat.
content.trans: 李雅总是愿意帮我，就像滴水之恩，当涌泉相报一样。

content.text: Example three.
content.trans: 翻译成中文是：

content.text: I can't leave at the drop of a hat.
content.trans: 我不能像滴水一样离开。

content.text: I need time to prepare.
content.trans: 我需要时间来准备。

content.text: Okay. So as you can see, you can change it for different things,
content.trans: 好的。那么，你可以根据不同的事情来改变它，

content.text: but basically you're saying I can't do something immediately.
content.trans: 但是基本上你是在说，我现在不能立即做某事。

content.text: Yeah. And it is almost always attached to this idea of doing something or going somewhere,
content.trans: 是的。它几乎总是附着在这个做某事或去某个地方的想法上，

content.text: being somewhere.
content.trans: 正在某个地方。

content.text: Mm hmm. Very good. At the drop of a hat.
content.trans: 嗯，嗯。很好。一拍即合。

content.text: All right. Now our final phrase here for this lesson.
content.trans: 好的。现在这个课程的最后一句话在这里。

content.text: So Veronica was saying, I can't go to India at the drop of a hat.
content.trans: 所以维多利亚正在说，我不能去印度，就像在一瞬间。

content.text: And she also said, I just can't build a relationship on a foundation of lies.
content.trans: 她还说，我不能建立一个基于谎言的关系。

content.text: Okay. A foundation of lies.
content.trans: 好的。谎言的基础。

content.text: To build something on a foundation of lies.
content.trans: 要建立在谎言的基础之上。

content.text: Now this is interesting. Let's take a look at this.
content.trans: 现在这个很有趣。让我们看看这个。

content.text: A foundation. What is that?
content.trans: 一个基础。那是什么？

content.text: Well, you know you have a house, right?
content.trans: 是的，你知道你有一个房子吗？

content.text: And the part that's in the ground that supports the house is the foundation.
content.trans: 地基是支撑房子的根基。

content.text: Okay. So it supports the entire structure.
content.trans: 好的。所以它支持整个结构。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 右。

content.text: So here she refers to the lies as the foundation.
content.trans: 所以她把谎言称为基础。

content.text: Mm hmm. And that's no way to start a strong relationship, is it?
content.trans: 嗯，嗯。这不怎么好开始一段稳固的关系啊？

content.text: Exactly. So we use it metaphorically in this way,
content.trans: 正确。因此，我们使用它像这样来使用。

content.text: but we can always, but we always have to say it,
content.trans: 但是，我们总是可以的，但总是必须说它。

content.text: but we always have to use the verb build.
content.trans: 但是，我们总是要使用动词 "建造"。

content.text: Okay. So it's basically to make something on a base of something else, right?
content.trans: 是的。嗯，基本上就是把某物的基础变成另一物，对吗？

content.text: Uh huh. So for example, a strong relationship is built on a foundation of trust.
content.trans: 嗯，所以比如，一个强关系建立在信任的基础之上。

content.text: Or this country was built on a foundation of liberty.
content.trans: 这个国家建立在自由的基础之上。

content.text: Very good. So always use foundation with built.
content.trans: 很好。所以始终使用底妆。

content.text: Mm hmm. Very good. Very interesting.
content.trans: 嗯，嗯。很好。很好。

content.text: And well, I think we should listen to this dialogue for the last time.
content.trans: 而且，我认为我们应当就此对话的最后一刻听取意见。

content.text: And then we'll come back and talk a little bit more about Veronica and Steven.
content.trans: 然后我们将继续谈谈维奥拉和斯蒂芬。

content.text: Veronica, wait.
content.trans: 对不起，我无法直接翻译中文到另一种语言。不过，我可以提供一些关于如何在中文中进行翻译的建议：

content.text: Come on, honey. Get back in the car. Let's tug it over. Okay?
content.trans: 喂，妈妈。坐好，别动车了。让我们拉它过去吧。好的？

content.text: No. I'm tired of your lies.
content.trans: 我不再接受你的谎言。

content.text: I don't know who you are anymore.
content.trans: 我不认识你了。

content.text: Veronica, it's me. The man that has and always will love you.
content.trans: Veronica，你就是我。永远爱你的人。

content.text: I'm sorry that I've lied to you. Believe me.
content.trans: 对不起，我让你相信了什么。让我相信。

content.text: It's been hard for me as well. And time and again, I've thought of coming clean.
content.trans: 我也有点难。每次想到要坦白，我都觉得很难。

content.text: But I couldn't put you or my mission at risk.
content.trans: 但是，我不能把你的或我的使命置于风险。

content.text: It's all over now. My assignment is complete.
content.trans: 现在一切都结束了。我的任务已完成。

content.text: And now I have to go back to India.
content.trans: 现在我必须回到印度。

content.text: What? Are you kidding?
content.trans: 什么？你是不是在开玩笑？

content.text: Is there anything else I should know before I never see you again?
content.trans: 是再见到你之前，您应该知道什么吗？

content.text: How could you deceive me like that?
content.trans: 如何能欺骗我这么愚蠢？

content.text: Yes.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: Veronica, I know that this isn't the best time
content.trans: Veronica, 我知道这并不是最好的时机。

content.text: and you probably hate me right now.
content.trans: 你肯定讨厌我了。

content.text: But I want to be completely forthright with you.
content.trans: 但是，我想完全坦诚与你。

content.text: I know deep in my heart that you are the best thing that has ever happened to me.
content.trans: 我深感内心深处，你是我所经历的最好事情。

content.text: Veronica, will you marry me?
content.trans: Veronica，你会嫁给我吗？

content.text: Come with me to India, baby.
content.trans: 请跟我来印度，宝贝。

content.text: I can't make it for everything that's happened, but I can promise you my undying love.
content.trans: 我不能为所有的发生的事情而改变，但我保证我的永恒爱恋。

content.text: I will be the most devoted husband and I will cherish you always.
content.trans: 我将是最忠诚的丈夫，我会永远爱你。

content.text: Steven, I can't just leave everything at the drop of a hat
content.trans: 对不起，我无法直接翻译中文。不过，我可以尝试用英文来表达你的意思：

content.text: with everything that has happened between us.
content.trans: 一切发生过的，都与我们有关。

content.text: I just don't know you anymore.
content.trans: 我只知道你了。

content.text: I just can't build a relationship on a foundation of lies.
content.trans: 我根本不能建立在谎言之上的关系。

content.text: I do love you, but I can't go with you.
content.trans: 我爱您，但我不愿意跟着你。

content.text: I'm sorry. I love you.
content.trans: 我非常抱歉。我爱你。

content.text: This is the last call for flight A15 from Los Angeles to Hyderabad.
content.trans: 这是从洛杉矶飞往赫尔默特的最后呼叫。

content.text: I'm sorry, sir. We can't wait any longer. You must board the plane.
content.trans: 对不起，先生。我们不能再等了。您必须登机。

content.text: Are you waiting for someone?
content.trans: 是等某人吗？

content.text: I was, but I don't think she's coming.
content.trans: 我曾经，但我不认为她会来。

content.text: So, Marco, I think I see a bit of a tear there in the corner of your eye.
content.trans: 所以，马科，我似乎看到了你眼睛角落的一丝泪痕。

content.text: I'm very sad. I can't believe he proposed and she just said no, just like that.
content.trans: 我非常难过。他提出，她却只是说不，就像这样。

content.text: It's not supposed to happen.
content.trans: 它不会发生。

content.text: Plus, he was inviting her to India and exotic getaway and promising.
content.trans: 此外，他还邀请她去了印度和异国情调的度假，并承诺。

content.text: Exotic getaway for the rest of her life.
content.trans: 外太空的度假，她将永远享受。

content.text: Well, what do you think will happen?
content.trans: 好的，你认为会发生什么？

content.text: Part 10, it all ends.
content.trans: 第10部分，一切结束了。

content.text: So, do you think they all just keep on living their separate lives?
content.trans: 所以，你们是不是都只是各自的生活？

content.text: Will they meet again?
content.trans: 将这句话翻译成中文，可以得到以下结果：

content.text: Who knows? Come to our website and tell us what you think will happen.
content.trans: 谁也不知道？来我们的网站，告诉我们你认为会发生什么。

content.text: So, you can find us at englispod.com.
content.trans: 所以，您可以在这里找到我们：englispod.com。

content.text: Alright, don't miss our finale of this lesson and until next time, we'll see you guys there.
content.trans: 好的，别忘了我们的课程总结会，直到下一次见！
